create_eagle_draft_npu_graph_runner: create an EAGLEDraftNpuGraphRunner instance initialized with an EAGLEWorker for NPU-based speculative decoding
init_arch_map: initialize the architecture map with MLA and MHA attention attribute names and types for graph updates
create_npu_graph: create a torch.npu.NPUGraph instance for capturing and replaying speculative draft computation graphs
capture_npu_graph: capture a computation graph within an NPU graph context with auto-dispatch and stream synchronization
replay_graph: replay a captured NPU graph with updated sequence lengths for each draft step under MLA attention
